contract.file: caller-owned, already durably published, exclusive serialized content owner; read/write absolute I/O/stat/resize/flush; reject APPEND/ASYNC; no file close/lock/namespace publication
contract.format: version1 big-endian descriptor plus two4096-byte current commit witnesses, bounded sequenced checksummed frames; exact binary binding/generation/MQTT level/payload schema
contract.commit: frame writes -> data sync -> BOTH latest witnesses -> publication sync -> caller success
contract.failure: before first witness IO/NOT_COMMITTED; from first witness UNCERTAIN/MAY_BE_COMMITTED; both poison until fresh open/replay
contract.recovery: one bounded transaction per Next; stage application state through EMPTY; validate highest selected committed prefix without older fallback; then truncate+sync only proven uncommitted suffix
contract.memory: one upfront sizeof(private Journal)+4096+MaxTransactionBytes+Binding.Size allocation; no heap/payload copy on successful Append; caller payload/recovery staging and Core/CRT/kernel storage additional
contract.cost: nonempty transaction: two payload CRC scans, three frame writes, two4096-byte witness writes, two native sync barriers; short I/O may require more physical calls
contract.security: CRC detects accidental corruption, not authentication/antirollback; device/filesystem sync and no unrelated-byte damage assumptions explicit
